summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by H World Group Ltd (a Cayman Islands-incorporated, NASDAQ- and HKEX-listed hotel operator) to provide its notice of annual general meeting and proxy materials. No special situation event is present. The filing only covers standard agenda items: ratification of auditor Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu, re-election of two directors, and authorizations. Record dates are May 18, 2026, with the AGM set for June 26, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event is announced or discussed. This is a purely procedural disclosure required for foreign private issuers. No deal terms apply.
